summary: A city lookout was planned for San Vicente Mountain in 1924; the Army ran a Nike missile site there 1956-68, and it is now San Vicente Mountain Park.

access.note: San Vicente Mountain Park is open and reached by a ten-minute walk from the parking area; the marker says vehicles beyond one point need handicapped permits.

visit.trail_note: About a ten-minute walk on a wide dirt road from the parking area.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a build date for the city lookout or says what became of it. The record's gone status rests on the FFLA list alone, which we did not quote. The 1924 item describes a plan. The LAFD Mountain Patrol history (lafra.org) says the department built three lookout stations and does not name San Vicente, so it is not used. An Angeles Adventures lookouts blog appeared in search and may cover this lookout; it was not read because the page budget was spent. The Nike site is at San Vicente Mountain Park; whether it sits on the old lookout's summit is not stated.
